info.title: Chargeback Guarantee
info.description:
# Riskified API for Fraud Prevention and Risk Management

This API allows merchants to submit orders for review, check order status, and manage the complete order lifecycle.

## Authentication
All API requests must include the following headers:
- `X-RISKIFIED-SHOP-DOMAIN`: Your shop domain registered with Riskified
- `X-RISKIFIED-HMAC-SHA256`: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the request body using your authentication token
- `Accept`: `application/vnd.riskified.com; version=2`
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`

## Environments
- Sandbox: Used for testing and integration
- Production: Used for live transactions

## Integration Types
Riskified supports different integration types:
- **Pre-authorization Synchronous**: Review orders before payment authorization
- **Post-authorization Synchronous**: Review orders after payment authorization with synchronous response
- **Post-authorization Asynchronous**: Review orders after payment authorization with asynchronous response

tags.description: Operations that allow you to send orders to Riskified for fraud review before payment authorization

post.description:
The `/decide` endpoint is used to request that Riskified review an order for fraud after the customer has input their payment data and completed the purchase. This allows us to analyze the full order data when providing a decision. Riskified's decision is returned synchronously in the response to the `/decide` API request. If order data changes after an initial approved decision, the `/decide` API is called to update Riskified and receive a decision based on the new order data.

When the `/decide` API is used to send Riskified updated order details, be sure to pass the same order ID in the payload as was used in the initial decide request.

recommendation.description:
Textual status describing the PSD2 recommendation.

 Possible values are: 
 - `sca` - requesting exemption not recommended
 - `tra` - order is recommended and should be liable for exemption request
 - `low_value` - the order qualifies for the Low Value Transaction (LVT) exemption
 - `out_of_scope` - the order is out of scope for PSD2

browser_ip.description: The customer's browser IP address at the time of order checkout.

total_price.description: The sum of all the prices of all the items in the order, taxes and discounts included (must be positive). Please note, rewards (e.g. gift cards) or store credits should be reflected under the charge_free_payment_details object, but shouldn't be subtracted from the total price.

total_discounts.description: The total amount of the discounts to be applied to the price of the order.

referring_site.description: The webpage from which the customer accessed the shop.

line_items.description: A list of line item objects, each one containing information about an item in the order.

shipping_lines.description: **(Conditional Requirement)** A list of shipping line objects, each of which details the shipping methods used. Required when a physical item is being shipped OR for money remittance RECIPIENT data.

payment_details.description: A list of payment details. Should be passed as an array of nested payment_details objects. In cases where several payment methods are sent in the array, the first payment method shall correspond to the first billing address, etc.

customer.description: An object containing information about the customer.

billing_address.description: The mailing address associated with the payment method.

shipping_address.description: **(Conditional Requirement)** The mailing address to where the order will be shipped. Required when a physical item is being shipped OR for money remittance RECIPIENT data.

source.description: The platform that the order originated from.

ai_agent.description: Should only be populated for autonomous agentic orders — i.e. where the AI agent completes the checkout end-to-end without the consumer manually interacting with the merchant site. For orders where an agent refers the consumer to the merchant site and the consumer completes checkout manually, use the existing referring_site field instead.

client_details.description: An object containing information about the browsing session.

name.description: A secondary identifier for the order (if exists).

cart_token.description: Session ID for this order. Must match the `session_details.cart_token` value set by the Beacon JavaScript snippet. For standard integrations, this value is automatically generated by Beacon. For merchants who manage their own sessions, the same session ID must be passed to both the Beacon and this field. Must remain consistent throughout a purchase flow. Max 100 characters.

checkout_id.description: **(Conditional Requirement)** The unique identifier of the Checkout that created this order. Use if checkout has previously been created for this order.

updated_at.description: The date and time (ISO8601) when the order was last modified.

note.example: Customer requested delivery before end of week.

discount_codes.description: A list of discount code objects, each one containing information about an item in the order.

vendor_id.description: A unique id representing the selling vendor.

vendor_name.description:
**(Conditional Requirement)** Required if there is an affiliated partner. 

The name of the selling vendor. Examples of affiliated partners include: metasearch engine, white label partner.

order_type.description: **(Conditional Requirement)** Usually omitted, set to 'test' when sending test orders (will be excluded from review). Required when sending test orders.

submission_reason.description: **(Conditional Requirement)** The underlying reason for submitting the order to review. Required if there are different segments for review.

decision.description: **(Conditional Requirement)** The merchant decision details for the order. Required for pre-authentication merchants.

charge_free_payment_details.description: **(Conditional Requirement)** A partial sum of an order as non risk (e.g. gift card amount). Required for credit card and gift card/store credit payments, for Travel/Flights industries.

partner_sub_merchant_id.description: **(Conditional Requirement)**: Required only for Resell Partners. A unique id representing a specific merchant onboarded by a Riskified Resell Partner. The value in this field serves to identify the merchant, and therefore must be unique. This value will be presented in Riskified’s UI, and therefore it is recommended to be human readable.

invoice_id.description:
ID of the invoice associated with the order. Merchants who want to split orders across separate invoices can use this field to assign each order to the relevant invoice.

For example: all orders with invoice_id = "europe" go to Invoice A, and all orders with invoice_id = "north-america" go to Invoice B.

**Note:** To use this field, merchants must coordinate with Riskified to ensure invoices are set up correctly in Riskified's Billing system. Alternatively, existing order fields (e.g., shipping country) can be used to split orders across invoices — coordinate with your Account Manager to set this up.

route_index.description:
A running index (starts with 1), describing the order of routes by time.
Each route_index and leg_index combination constitutes an individual line item. The two (2) route example below requires four (4) line items.

E.g: If an order contains 2 Routes:
New-York->London->Paris (connection in London)
New-York->London should have route_index=1, leg_index=1
London->Paris should have route_index=1, leg_index=2

Paris->London->New-York
Paris->London should have route_index=2, leg_index=1
London->New-York should have route_index=2, leg_index=2

seller.description: **(Conditional Requirement)** Required for marketplace or guest/host accommodations. Details about the seller of the item, relevant for marketplace orders.

vendor.description: **(Conditional Requirement)** Required if there is a different affiliated partner for each product or line item.

sub_category.description: The sub-category of the item. For event tickets, the sub-category of the event.

delivered_at.description: The planned delivery date of the product or item.

delivered_to.description:
**(Conditional Requirement)** Required for mixed shipment orders. The delivery type must contain one of the following values
shipping_address: The Order's shipping address is the end user's entered address.
store_pickup: If the end user selects store pickup, the shipping address value should contain the store's address.

drop_point.description: If the end user is handing the package at a drop-off point, the shipping address value should contain the drop off location address

size.description: The size of the item (e.g. shirt or shoe size)

registry_type.description: The registry type must contain one of the following values: wedding, baby, other

shipping_address_id.description: **(Conditional Requirement)** unique ID, is required in case of multiple shipping addresses.

pickup_date.description: Ride pickup date. Add corresponding timezone indication or ensure correct UTC standardization (ISO8601) e.g. 2019-07-24T14:55:00+2:00

route_index.description:
A running index (starts with 1), describing the order of routes by time.

 E.g: A return trip will be represented in two line_items, the onward trip line_item will be assigned with route_index = 1, the return trip line_item with route_index = 2.

leg_index.description: A running index (starts with 1), describing the order of legs in the same route. E.g: Will always equal 1, unless the rider needs to change a vehicle within a route.

pickup_latitude.description: The latitude part of the pickup location coordinates.

pickup_longitude.description: The longitude part of the pickup location coordinates.

dropoff_date.description: Ride dropoff date. Add corresponding timezone indication or ensure correct UTC standardization (ISO8601) e.g. 2019-07-24T14:55:00+2:00

dropoff_latitude.description: The latitude part of the dropoff location coordinates.

dropoff_longitude.description: The longitude part of the dropoff location coordinates.

transport_method.description: The transport method used, such as: taxi, car, rv, bus, plane, ship, train, tram, cruise

vehicle_class.description: Vehicle class, such as: economy, executive, van, etc.

tariff.description: Relevant tariff for the ride, such as: regular, night, 2, etc.

authorized_payment.description: Authorized pre-payment value for this ride (order currency).

damage_excess.description: Amount the customer is liable for in case of damage to the vehicle.

price.description: The price of one unit of the product.

quantity.description: The number of items that were ordered.

product_id.description: The id of the item. Limited to 256 characters

category.description: The category of the item. For event tickets, the category of the event.

brand.description: The brand name of the item.

product_type.description: The product type should contain the following value: event

requires_shipping.description: Should be equal to `false` for the digital items that don't require shipping.

Details the shipping methods used to deliver the items.
* Please note That this can either be an array or a standalone object

price.description: The price of the shipping method. Should be defaulted to 0 for money remittance.

title.description: The title of the shipping method. Should be "Bank Deposit" for money remittance.

company.description: The name of the shipping company.

shipping_address_id.description: **(Conditional Requirement)** unique ID, is required in case of multiple shipping addresses.

user_agent.description: The full User-Agent sent from the client.

accept_language.description: List of two-letter language codes sent from the client.

example.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/100.0.4896.75 Safari/537.36

external_status.description:
The external status, valid values are:
* approved: The order was approved by the merchant or the gateway.
* declined: Despite Riskified recommendation to approve, the merchant decided overturn the decision and decline it.
* cancelled: The order was cancelled due to non-fraud reasons, such as out of stock.
* declined_fraud: The order was not fulfilled due to fraud related reasons.
* declined_business: The order was declined by the merchant's business reasons.

decided_at.description: When the order was decided, ISO8601 format.

amount.description: The amount the decision is relevant on.

currency.description: The three letter code (ISO 4217) for the currency used for the payment.

notes.description: Free text for describing the decision.

example.notes: No suspicious activity detected; customer history clear.

first_name.description: The first name of the passenger.

last_name.description: The last name (surname) of the person associated with the address.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth for the passenger. Date part only (ISO8601).

nationality_code.description: The 2 letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) matching the passenger's nationality country.

document_type.description: The document type used for identification of the passenger (one of [Passport,ID,Visa]).

insurance_type.description: The passenger's insurance type/plan for his trip.

insurance_price.description: The passenger's insurance plan price matching the order currency.

document_issue_date.description: The issuing date of the passenger document (date part only using ISO8601 format).

document_expiration_date.description: The expiration date of the passenger document (date part only using ISO8601 format).

vendor_id.description: A unique id representing the selling vendor.

vendor_name.description: The name of the selling vendor. Examples of affiliated partners include: metasearch engine, white label partner.

customer.description: A Customer object representing the seller.

correspondence.description: Number of messages sent between the customer and the seller.

price_negotiated.description: True if the seller and customer negotiated the price between themselves.

starting_price.description: The original price of the order, prior to any negotiation between seller and customer.

network.description: The name of the social network.

account_url.description: Direct URL to the customer's profile page on the social network.

community_score.description: Aggregate community score for the customer

profile_picture.description: URL of the customer's profile picture.

email.description: Customer's email address registered on the social network.

bio.description: Short biography of the customer on the social network.

following.description: Number of users following the customer on the social network.

followed.description: Number of users followed by the customer on the social network.

posts.description: Number of posts published by the customer on the social network.

auth_token.description: The authentication token of the user.

social_data.description: The user data from the network.

RiskifiedSignature.name: x-riskified-hmac-sha256
RiskifiedSignature.description:
Verification hash for the Request.
Generated by performing an SHA256 encryption on the request's POST body and calculating the HMAC hash of the result using your Riskified authentication token.
Please use UTF8 encoding.

ContentType.name: Content-Type
ContentType.description: As payloads are sent to Riskified in JSON format, value should be: `application/json`

Accept.name: accept
Accept.description: Specify the version of the API to target. For example, to target the latest version of the API, use the following: `application/vnd.riskified.com; version=2`
